profile.headline: IT/Software Development Manager, Engineering Project/Program Manager, Software/Firmware Engineer
profile.summary:
Engineering project/program manager with experience in PC software, embedded software / firmware, and Microsoft SQL Server database design and development. Broad experience with all aspects of the product development cycle, including marketing specification, design, development, testing, and manufacturing support. High-security applications.

Specialties: Programming and Mark-up Languages (VB.NET, C#, C++/CLI, embedded C, T-SQL, XML, HTML, XHTML), Integrated Development Environments (Microsoft Visual Studio 2003-2017, IAR, CodeWarrior, Eclipse), Technologies (TI MSP430, 8051, ARM, PIC, RFID, IEEE 802.15, Wi-Fi)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Development of a data pipeline infrastructure project, employing Azure cloud services, Kubernetes, and NoSQL technologies such as Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK), ensuring timely delivery and high-quality results.
• Utilized a software stack including C#, .NET 7.0, NativeAOT, Windows services, and desktop applications to design and implement robust, efficient, and scalable solutions.
• Actively participated in Agile development practices, including code reviews, demos, QA orientation, sprint planning, sprint retrospectives, design meetings, and daily huddles, ensuring effective collaboration and project success.
• Conducted code reviews and provided mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement while emphasizing best practices in C#, .NET, and other relevant technologies.
• Integrated OpenTelemetry for monitoring and observability, improving system reliability and performance.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
• Contract engineering services, especially software engineering services
• Business analysis, process discovery, and business value creation services
• Manager upskilling and project collaboration services
• Web Development (ASP.NET Core, .NET 6, C#, MVC, Razor, Blazor, Bootstrap 5.2.1, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, DevExpress, Visual Studio 2022, VS Code, Azure DevOps, Multi-tenant)
• SQL/NoSQL Database Development (MS SQL Server, Maria DB / MySQL, Elasticsearch)
• Cloud Services (Azure)
• Integration of MIT/Apache 2.0 Licensed Open-source Software into Web Projects

positions.title: Director of Software Engineering
positions.description:
• Lead, manage, and hold accountable (LMA) the IT Department Software Development Team
• Optimize performance of the development team to achieve maximum efficiency
• Participate as member of the LockNet Leadership Team
• Software architecture, design, and implementation
• Internal software (including Windows software, web, mobile, etc.)
• Integration with ERP, Third Party Systems, Etc.
• Work with Leadership, Director of IT, and Technology Steering Committee to identify and implement third party software including ERP
• Collaborate consistently with Director of IT to maximize software efficiency and performance on LockNet hardware and infrastructure
• Implement and lead a formal SDLC methodology for software development that includes: Defined Sprints, Formal work intake process (i.e. user stories & prioritized backlog), Daily SCRUM, Weekly story grooming (or as needed), Formal release process that includes Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Testing prior to production release

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
• Active and passionate member the Executive Leadership Team and participated in quarterly and annual off-site planning sessions with company ownership 
• Managed up to four direct reports across areas of software engineering and IT operations 
• Lead the software engineering team, setting architectural direction for desktop mobile, and web apps, phone-system, network and server architecture
• Nearly daily use of SQL Server and other Microsoft technologies to provide profit-focused data analytics to multiple areas of the business
• Enabled entire office staff to work from home due to COVID-19 risk on very short notice, and rolled out safety-focused systems changes to protect essential workers at warehouse
• Microsoft SQL Server 2017 upgrade, database administration and maintenance
• Other Microsoft infrastructure management including SQL Server Report Services, SharePoint, Office 365, and a clustered server environment with automatic failover and high-availability 
• Roll-out of multiple information security improvement initiatives (email and internet browsing risk awareness training, firewall upgrades to implement cloud-enhanced DPI/SSL scanning of traffic, change to website whitelisting model, modernized endpoint protection software) 
• Implemented automated 100+ TB offsite backup storage of all critical SQL data, file server data, server/VM images on a shoestring budget of $6000 with a recurring monthly cost of only $350

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Development and maintenance of multiple Windows desktop applications created using WinForms for VB.NET, DevExpress UI components, and Microsoft T-SQL
• Integration with the Macola Progression ERP system at the SQL database level
• Maintenance of multiple cross-platform internal and external-facing mobile apps created using Xamarin/C#.NET
• Maintenance of ASP.NET internal and external-facing web applications on IIS web servers
• Porting of legacy Microsoft Access application to newer .NET technologies
• Collaborated with owners, manager, and direct reports across the company to develop scopes of work

positions.title: Program Manager, Connected Devices
positions.description:
•	Project management activities for the software projects related to the residential Internet of Things (IoT) products such as fans, lights, and wall controls sold under the Haiku Home brand
•	Provided management support for a team of up seven mobile app and firmware developers
•	Coordinated AWS-hosted cloud development activities with a contract software development company
•	Interfaced with west-coast IoT integration partner companies on collaborative initiatives
•	Attended conferences and performed media interviews on behalf of the company
•	Interviewed prospective developer candidates
•	Worked with product management to capture and create engineering requirements
•	Advocated on behalf of the software engineers on my team



Related Links:
•	https://www.datainnovation.org/2015/06/5-qs-for-jerrill-johnson-program-manager-for-connected-devices-at-big-ass-solutions/
•	http://www.stitcher.com/podcast/fix-it-home-improvement-5/fix-it-home-improvement/e/ceiling-fans-37982593

patents.title: INTEGRATED THERMAL COMFORT CONTROL SYSTEM WITH VARIABLE MODE OF OPERATION
patents.description: A system for controlling thermal comfort in a space is provided with a variable mode of operation. The system may include a conditioner for conditioning air in the space, and a sensor for measuring a temperature in the space. A controller is provided for controlling the conditioner based on the temperature sensed by the sensor, and a fan for circulating air within the space is regulated based on the temperature sensed by the sensor. A related system for controlling a fan based on height is also provided, as is a system and method for easily and efficiently determining the height of a fan using a simple camera, such as one on a “smart” phone. A further aspect pertains to a controller, such as for example a portable handheld device, having a user interface adapted for suggesting an increase in a set point temperature of a thermostat based on the selected speed of the fan.
